# KI: Agentic Neural Network (ANN) Textual Backpropagation & Momentum Smoothing

## Operational Summary
Treating a multi-agent workflow DAG as an Agentic Neural Network allows execution errors to be translated into structured textual loss signals. Global gradients identify failed layers and inter-layer structural updates, while local layerwise gradients generate refined prompt instructions and insert specialized validator nodes. Applying momentum velocity smoothing prevents oscillatory prompt degradation across iterative optimization loops.
